title: Nutty Venezuelan Pretzel Empanadas
description: A malty and snappy Venezuelan dish featuring pretzels and papillote, served in a copper mug, with a gluten-free friendly option. This indulgent treat is perfect for a snack or dessert.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together the malty flour, pretzels, and papillote.
Add the butter, eggs, salt, sugar, and vanilla extract to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place in a copper mug.
Bake the empanadas in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Remove the empanadas from the oven and let them cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the empanadas warm and enjoy.
